content: Xenni ikkar Dawud, yuyur, uca yudef Yunatan ɣar tendint.
Xenni yiweḍ Dawud ɣar Nub ɣar ukehhan Aximalik. Aximalik iffeɣ-dd ɣar Dawud yarjef, inna as: “Mayemmi cek weḥḥdek, war kidek uřa d ijj?”

Dawud inna i ukehhan Aximalik: “Ajeǧid iwca ayi ijj n wareqqas, inna ayi: ‘Uřa d ijj war ittriggib x tmesřact i d ac dd-ssekkeɣ u xak ggiɣ!’ Sargbeɣ i imsexxaren aqa ad ruḥen ɣar wemcan-a d wemcan-in.
Xenni řexxu, min ɣarek? Ewc ayi xemsa n tecnifin deg ufus niɣ min ma tzemmared ad tafed.”
Akehhan yarra-dd x Dawud, inna: “War din aɣrum i macca ɣar ufus, mɣir aɣrum amqeddes waha i da. Meɛlik imsexxaren tuɣa ttaggʷejen waha x temɣarin!”

Dawud yarra-dd x ukehhan, inna as: “S tidett, timɣarin ttwaḥeyydent xaneɣ am mammec teǧa lqaɛida zeg wami ffɣeɣ, u řeqcuɛ n imsexxaren ttwaqeddsen. Waxxa amenni manawya d ijj n wuffuɣ am řebda, aqa uffuɣ-a ittwaqeddes ass-a s řeqcuɛ.”
Xenni iwca as ukehhan aɣrum iqeddsen, maɣar war tuɣi dinni aɣrum mɣir aɣrum n wescan nni ittwakkes zi zzat i wudem n SIDI, ḥima ad ssarsen deg wemcan nnes aɣrum iḥma deg wass nni ittwakkes.
Deg wass nni tuɣa dinni ijj zeg imsexxaren n Cawul. Netta tuɣa ittwaḥṣar dinni zzat i wudem n SIDI. Qqaren as Duwaɛ, zi Idum. Netta tuɣa ɣares ṣṣulṭa aṭṭas jar imeksawen inni iǧan ɣar Cawul.
Uca inna Dawud i Aximalik: “Ma war da ɣarek ict n lansa niɣ ijj n ssif ɣar ufus? Maɣar war kidi ksiɣ ssif d řesnaḥ inu deg ufus inu, minzi tamesřact n ujeǧid tuɣa tᵉttqeǧiq.”

Inna ukehhan: “Ssif n Julyat, Afilisṭini wenni x tɣeřbed di Řewḍa n Teɣzurt n Ila, aqa-t da, ittwanneḍ deg ijj n warruḍ awarni i upalṭu n ikehhanen. Mařa texsed ad t teksid, ksi t, minzi war da walu mɣir wanita.” Inna Dawud: “War iǧi ijj am netta! Ewc ayi t!”
Ikkar Dawud, yarweř deg wass nni zzat i wudem n Cawul uca netta yusa-dd ɣar Axic, ajeǧid n Jat.

Imsexxaren n Axic nnan as: “Ma wanita war iǧi d Dawud, ajeǧid n temmurt? Ma war iǧi d wenni zi ɣennjent, ceḍḥent temɣarin s nnubtat, qqarent: ‘Cawul iɣřeb x řuřuf nnes, maca Dawud x ɛecra n řuřuf nnes?’”
Dawud yarra awařen-a ɣar wuř nnes u tuɣa itteggʷed aṭṭas zzat i wudem n Axic, ajeǧid n Jat.

Xenni igga ixef nnes axmi iweddar řeɛqeř nnes zzat i tiṭṭawin nsen, igga axmi ijjen dayes aṭemmes umi xas ssarsen ifassen, uca ibda ixebbec di tewwura n tewwart n tendint, ijja ikuffan nnes hekkwan-dd x tmart nnes.
Xenni inna Axic i imsexxaren nnes: “Xzarem, kenniw tᵉttwařam aqa aryaz ibbuhři. Mayemmi i-t-i-dd-tiwyem ɣari?”
Ma ttxeṣṣan ayi ibuhařiyyen, aqa tiwyem-dd ɣari wanita maḥend ad ɣari igg tubbuheřya? Ma d wanita i dd ɣa yadfen ɣar taddart inu?”
